**# Data Dictionary**



**## 1. Conventions**



**- This dictionary describes the 11 CSV tables generated by `src/generate\_data.py`.**

**- All generated records are synthetic.**

**- Types are logical types. For SQLite, IDs, dates, and timestamps can use `TEXT`; whole numbers and Boolean values can use `INTEGER`; monetary values and probabilities can use `NUMERIC`.**

**- Required means the generated field contains a value. Optional means NULL is permitted by the generator.**

**- Dates use `YYYY-MM-DD`.**

**- Timestamps use UTC ISO 8601 where applicable.**

**- Monetary values use USD and two decimal places.**

**- Controlled values are case-sensitive.**

**- Primary keys are unique within their table.**

**- Foreign-key references must resolve to the corresponding parent table.**

**- The generator's full scale creates 2,000 representatives, 2,000 accounts, 20,000 opportunities, and four territories.**

**- The starter scale creates 20 representatives, 20 accounts, 200 opportunities, and four territories.**



**## 2. Identifier formats**



**| Entity | Example | Format |**

**|---|---|---|**

**| SalesRep | `REP-000001` | `REP-` followed by 6 digits |**

**| Territory | `TER-0001` | `TER-` followed by 4 digits |**

**| Account | `ACC-000001` | `ACC-` followed by 6 digits |**

**| Opportunity | `OPP-2026-000001` | `OPP-`, 4-digit year, 6-digit sequence |**

**| Stage | `STAGE-001` | `STAGE-` followed by 3 digits |**

**| StageHistory | `STG-OPP-2026-000001-001` | `STG-`, opportunity ID, 3-digit event sequence |**

**| Activity | `ACT-OPP-2026-000001-001` | `ACT-`, opportunity ID, 3-digit sequence |**

**| Quota | `QUOTA-REP-000001-2025Q1` | `QUOTA-`, representative ID, fiscal quarter |**

**| HistoricalBooking | `BOOK-OPP-2026-000001` | `BOOK-` followed by opportunity ID |**

**| ForecastSnapshot | `FCST-2025-01-31-001` | `FCST-`, snapshot date, 3-digit sequence for that date |**

**| RepTerritoryAssignment | `RTA-000001` | `RTA-` followed by 6 digits |**



**## 3. SalesRep**



**Source: `data/raw/sales\_rep.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| rep\_id | TEXT | Yes | `REP-` + 6 digits | Yes (PK) | Match `^REP-\[0-9]{6}$` |**

**| rep\_name | TEXT | Yes | Synthetic representative name | No | Non-empty |**

**| email | TEXT | Yes | Synthetic email address | Yes | Unique; generated using `example.test` |**

**| hire\_date | DATE | Yes | Calendar date | No | Valid date within the generation horizon |**

**| employment\_status | TEXT | Yes | `Active` | No | Must match the generated employment status |**

**| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | Yes | UTC ISO 8601 timestamp | No | Valid timestamp |**



**## 4. Territory**



**Source: `data/raw/territory.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| territory\_id | TEXT | Yes | `TER-` + 4 digits | Yes (PK) | Match `^TER-\[0-9]{4}$` |**

**| territory\_name | TEXT | Yes | Synthetic territory label | Yes | Non-empty |**

**| region | TEXT | Yes | `North`, `South`, `East`, `West` | No | Must be in configured region list |**

**| country\_code | TEXT | Yes | `US` | No | Two uppercase letters |**

**| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | Yes | UTC ISO 8601 timestamp | No | Valid timestamp |**

**| status | TEXT | Yes | `Active` | No | Must match generated status |**



**## 5. Account**



**Source: `data/raw/account.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| account\_id | TEXT | Yes | `ACC-` + 6 digits | Yes (PK) | Match `^ACC-\[0-9]{6}$` |**

**| account\_name | TEXT | Yes | Synthetic account name | No | Non-empty |**

**| industry | TEXT | Yes | Technology, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, Finance, Education, Logistics, Telecommunications | No | Must be in configured industry list |**

**| account\_status | TEXT | Yes | `Prospect`, `Customer` | No | Must be consistent with generated account conversion logic |**

**| territory\_id | TEXT | Yes | Territory ID | No (FK) | Must reference Territory |**

**| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | Yes | UTC ISO 8601 timestamp | No | Valid timestamp |**



**## 6. Opportunity**



**Source: `data/raw/opportunity.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| opportunity\_id | TEXT | Yes | `OPP-YYYY-NNNNNN` | Yes (PK) | Match `^OPP-\[0-9]{4}-\[0-9]{6}$`; year corresponds to creation cohort |**

**| opportunity\_name | TEXT | Yes | Synthetic product opportunity name | No | Non-empty |**

**| account\_id | TEXT | Yes | Account ID | No (FK) | Must reference Account |**

**| owner\_rep\_id | TEXT | Yes | SalesRep ID | No (FK) | Must reference SalesRep |**

**| territory\_id | TEXT | Yes | Territory ID | No (FK) | Must reference Territory; selected using the owner's effective assignment at creation |**

**| source\_opportunity\_id | TEXT | No | Opportunity ID | No (self-FK) | NULL in the current generator; if populated, must reference an existing opportunity |**

**| created\_date | DATE | Yes | Calendar date | No | Valid date between 2025-01-01 and 2026-12-31 |**

**| expected\_close\_date | DATE | Yes | Calendar date | No | On or after created\_date |**

**| amount | NUMERIC(14,2) | Yes | USD; positive amount | No | Finite positive value with two decimal places |**

**| currency\_code | TEXT | Yes | `USD` | No | Must equal `USD` |**

**| product | TEXT | Yes | `Platform`, `Analytics`, `Automation`, `Integration`, `Support` | No | Must be in configured product list |**

**| current\_stage | TEXT | Yes | `Prospecting`, `Qualification`, `Proposal`, `Negotiation`, `Closed Won`, `Closed Lost` | No | Must correspond to the final generated lifecycle stage |**

**| closed\_date | DATE | No | Calendar date or NULL | No | Present for Won/Lost outcomes; derived from final StageHistory event |**

**| outcome | TEXT | Yes | `Open`, `Won`, `Lost` | No | Must agree with current\_stage |**



**## 7. Stage**



**Source: `data/raw/stage.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| stage\_id | TEXT | Yes | `STAGE-` + 3 digits | Yes (PK) | Match `^STAGE-\[0-9]{3}$` |**

**| stage\_name | TEXT | Yes | Six configured stage names | Yes | Must match the configured stage catalogue |**

**| stage\_order | INTEGER | Yes | 1–6 | Yes | Prospecting=1, Qualification=2, Proposal=3, Negotiation=4, Closed Won=5, Closed Lost=6 |**

**| default\_probability | NUMERIC(5,4) | Yes | 0.0000–1.0000; proportion | No | Must match the configured probability for the stage |**

**| is\_closed\_stage | INTEGER/BOOLEAN | Yes | `0`, `1` | No | `1` only for Closed Won and Closed Lost |**



**Configured probabilities:**



**| Stage | Probability |**

**|---|---:|**

**| Prospecting | 0.10 |**

**| Qualification | 0.25 |**

**| Proposal | 0.50 |**

**| Negotiation | 0.80 |**

**| Closed Won | 1.00 |**

**| Closed Lost | 0.00 |**



**## 8. StageHistory**



**Source: `data/raw/stage\_history.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| stage\_history\_id | TEXT | Yes | `STG-<opportunity-id>-NNN` | Yes (PK) | Unique generated event ID |**

**| opportunity\_id | TEXT | Yes | Opportunity ID | No (FK) | Must reference Opportunity |**

**| from\_stage\_id | TEXT | No | Stage ID or NULL | No (FK) | NULL for the initial event; otherwise references the previous stage |**

**| to\_stage\_id | TEXT | Yes | Stage ID | No (FK) | Must reference Stage |**

**| changed\_by\_rep\_id | TEXT | Yes | SalesRep ID | No (FK) | Must reference SalesRep |**

**| changed\_at | TIMESTAMP | Yes | UTC ISO 8601 timestamp | No | Must not precede opportunity creation; ordered by event sequence |**

**| reason | TEXT | Yes | Synthetic lifecycle explanation | No | Non-empty |**

**| event\_sequence | INTEGER | Yes | Positive integer | Unique per opportunity | Starts at 1 and increases by 1 for each opportunity |**



**## 9. Activity**



**Source: `data/raw/activity.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| activity\_id | TEXT | Yes | `ACT-<opportunity-id>-NNN` | Yes (PK) | Unique generated activity ID |**

**| opportunity\_id | TEXT | Yes | Opportunity ID | No (FK) | Must reference Opportunity |**

**| rep\_id | TEXT | Yes | SalesRep ID | No (FK) | Must reference SalesRep |**

**| activity\_type | TEXT | Yes | `Call`, `Email`, `Meeting` | No | Must be one of the generated activity types |**

**| activity\_date | DATE | Yes | Calendar date | No | Must not precede opportunity creation or exceed the generation as-of date |**

**| subject | TEXT | Yes | Synthetic activity description | No | Non-empty |**

**| outcome | TEXT | Yes | `Completed` | No | Must match generated activity outcome |**



**Note: The current implementation generates opportunity-linked activities. It does not generate separate account-level activities or fields such as `activity\_status`, `occurred\_at`, or `notes`.**



**## 10. Quota**



**Source: `data/raw/quota.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| quota\_id | TEXT | Yes | `QUOTA-<rep-id>-YYYYQn` | Yes (PK) | Must contain the row's representative ID and quarter |**

**| rep\_id | TEXT | Yes | SalesRep ID | No (FK) | Must reference SalesRep |**

**| fiscal\_quarter | TEXT | Yes | `2025Q1`–`2026Q4` | No | Match `^202\[56]Q\[1-4]$` |**

**| quota\_amount | NUMERIC(14,2) | Yes | USD; 250000.00 | No | Generated as 250000.00 |**

**| currency\_code | TEXT | Yes | `USD` | No | Must equal `USD` |**



**A quota is generated for each representative for each of the eight quarters in the dataset horizon.**



**## 11. HistoricalBooking**



**Source: `data/raw/historical\_booking.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| booking\_id | TEXT | Yes | `BOOK-<opportunity-id>` | Yes (PK) | Must contain the linked opportunity ID |**

**| opportunity\_id | TEXT | Yes | Opportunity ID | Yes (FK) | Must reference a Won opportunity |**

**| account\_id | TEXT | Yes | Account ID | No (FK) | Must reference the opportunity's account |**

**| rep\_id | TEXT | Yes | SalesRep ID | No (FK) | Must match the opportunity owner |**

**| booking\_date | DATE | Yes | Calendar date | No | Derived from the opportunity close date |**

**| booking\_amount | NUMERIC(14,2) | Yes | USD; positive amount | No | Derived from the Won opportunity amount |**

**| currency\_code | TEXT | Yes | `USD` | No | Must equal `USD` |**



**Only Won opportunities generate HistoricalBooking records in the current implementation. Separate adjustment, reversal, and non-opportunity booking records are not generated.**



**## 12. ForecastSnapshot**



**Source: `data/raw/forecast\_snapshot.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| forecast\_snapshot\_id | TEXT | Yes | `FCST-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN` | Yes (PK) | Unique sequence within snapshot date |**

**| snapshot\_date | DATE | Yes | Monthly month-end date | No | One of the generated snapshot dates |**

**| opportunity\_id | TEXT | Yes | Opportunity ID | No (FK) | Must reference Opportunity; one row per opportunity per snapshot date |**

**| stage\_id | TEXT | Yes | Stage ID | No (FK) | Must reference Stage; represents stage as of snapshot date |**

**| amount | NUMERIC(14,2) | Yes | USD | No | Must match the source opportunity amount |**

**| expected\_close\_date | DATE | Yes | Calendar date | No | Original expected close date adjusted by snapshot slippage logic |**

**| last\_activity\_date | DATE | No | Calendar date or NULL | No | Latest activity date on or before snapshot date; NULL if none |**

**| stale\_days | INTEGER | Yes | Non-negative days | No | Days since last known activity, or since opportunity creation if no activity exists |**

**| is\_stale | INTEGER/BOOLEAN | Yes | `0`, `1` | No | True when stale\_days is at least 30 |**



**The generator creates 24 monthly month-end snapshot dates from January 31, 2025 through December 31, 2026.**



**The normal ForecastSnapshot CSV does not contain fields such as `forecast\_type`, `period\_start`, `period\_end`, `weighted\_amount`, `actual\_amount`, or `model\_version`. Weighted forecast values and grouped summaries are derived by downstream processing.**



**## 13. RepTerritoryAssignment**



**Source: `data/raw/rep\_territory\_assignment.csv`**



**| Field | Type | Required? | Allowed values / units | Unique? | Validation rule |**

**|---|---|---|---|---|---|**

**| assignment\_id | TEXT | Yes | `RTA-` + 6 digits | Yes (PK) | Match `^RTA-\[0-9]{6}$` |**

**| rep\_id | TEXT | Yes | SalesRep ID | No (FK) | Must reference SalesRep |**

**| territory\_id | TEXT | Yes | Territory ID | No (FK) | Must reference Territory |**

**| effective\_from | DATE | Yes | Calendar date | No | Inclusive assignment start |**

**| effective\_to | DATE | No | Calendar date or NULL | No | Exclusive assignment end; NULL indicates no defined end |**



**The generator creates one initial assignment for every representative. Approximately 20% of representatives receive a second assignment representing a territory transfer.**



**Assignment intervals use start-inclusive and end-exclusive semantics.**



**## 14. Relationship summary**



**| Parent entity | Child entity | Relationship | Implementation |**

**|---|---|---|---|**

**| Territory | Account | 1:N | Account has a territory\_id |**

**| Territory | Opportunity | 1:N | Opportunity has a territory\_id |**

**| SalesRep | Opportunity | 1:N | Opportunity has an owner\_rep\_id |**

**| Account | Opportunity | 1:N | Opportunity has an account\_id |**

**| Opportunity | StageHistory | 1:N | Each opportunity has lifecycle events |**

**| Stage | StageHistory | 1:N | Each event references a destination stage and may reference a source stage |**

**| Opportunity | Activity | 1:N | Activity is opportunity-linked |**

**| SalesRep | Activity | 1:N | Activity has a rep\_id |**

**| SalesRep | Quota | 1:N | Quotas are generated by representative and quarter |**

**| Opportunity | HistoricalBooking | 1:0..1 | A Won opportunity generates one booking |**

**| Account | HistoricalBooking | 1:N | Booking records reference accounts |**

**| SalesRep | HistoricalBooking | 1:N | Booking records reference credited representatives |**

**| Opportunity | ForecastSnapshot | 1:N | An opportunity may appear in multiple monthly snapshots |**

**| SalesRep | RepTerritoryAssignment | 1:N | Assignment records reference representatives |**

**| Territory | RepTerritoryAssignment | 1:N | Assignment records reference territories |**



**RepTerritoryAssignment is the effective-dated bridge between SalesRep and Territory. Across the dataset, it represents a many-to-many relationship over time.**



**## 15. Cross-table validation rules**



**1. Primary keys must be unique and non-null within each table.**

**2. Foreign keys must resolve to existing parent records.**

**3. Opportunity account, owner representative, and territory references must exist.**

**4. An opportunity's territory must correspond to the owner's effective assignment at opportunity creation.**

**5. StageHistory must reference an existing opportunity and valid stage records.**

**6. StageHistory event sequences must be ordered within each opportunity.**

**7. The first StageHistory event has a NULL `from\_stage\_id`.**

**8. Opportunity current\_stage and outcome must agree with the final lifecycle state.**

**9. Closed opportunities must have a valid closed\_date; open opportunities must have a NULL closed\_date.**

**10. HistoricalBooking must reference a Won opportunity and match its account, owner, close date, amount, and currency.**

**11. ForecastSnapshot must reference a valid opportunity and stage.**

**12. A historical snapshot must use only lifecycle and activity events known on or before its snapshot date.**

**13. An opportunity must not appear more than once on the same snapshot date.**

**14. Standard generated monetary records must use USD.**

**15. The anomaly dataset is deliberately corrupted for testing and must be evaluated separately from the clean dataset.**



**## 16. Anomaly-only fields and ground truth**



**The normal source CSV schema is distinct from the deliberately corrupted anomaly dataset.**



**The anomaly dataset contains five labelled issue types:**



**- `close\_date\_before\_creation`**

**- `mixed\_currency`**

**- `stage\_probability\_mismatch`**

**- `future\_information\_leak`**

**- `duplicate\_opportunity`**



**The stage-probability mismatch injection adds a `stage\_probability` field to the affected anomaly forecast data. This is an anomaly-testing extension and is not a normal ForecastSnapshot field.**



**Ground-truth labels are maintained separately under `data/anomalies/`. They are used to evaluate detection performance after validation and must not be used as inputs to the anomaly-detection rules.**
